policy_context.approval_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22: design and execute a bounded, contained M4 microbenchmark if safe; preserve all hard safety checks.
policy_context.execution_authorization_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22 authorizes this single-arm lock/reader/GC/writer diagnostic; no pair retry and no hard-gate bypass.
policy_context.resource_basis: 64 documents x 10 writer cycles; existing API emits 40 reader samples and 10 writer/GC samples. 512 MiB cgroup cap is an operation-specific estimate below the existing 1 GiB ceiling; fixed 3 GiB host reserve and all containment/integrity/cleanup gates remain unchanged.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Exploratory single-arm results are descriptive only; shared-host pressure and absent A/B control prohibit causal or architecture-win claims.
